DESIGN (rule drafted 2026-10-14 by the analyst; a smoke run on the preliminary core rows available during implementation was made; amended 2026-10-14 after code review to rank by the oriented AUC so the a priori directions of metrics.direction are respected; to be confirmed by the PI): candidates = the pool predictors without missing or constant values on the training rows and with an oriented univariable AUC >= min_discrimination on the training rows (the AUC of direction x value with the direction of metrics.direction; 'core' directions are set on the training rows of every fold or resample, i.e. max(AUC, 1 - AUC)), so that the model is not filled with uninformative predictors and a predictor associated with the opposite of its a priori sign cannot enter; ranked by that oriented AUC (ties: list order); taken in rank order, skipping any candidate with |Spearman rho| > max_abs_spearman against one already chosen, up to max_predictors (study plan: <= 3; fewer if the candidates run out); L2-penalised logistic regression (logistic_C) on the z-scored selected predictors; the index is the model log-odds; selected predictors whose fitted coefficient sign opposes their direction are reported. The training rows are the core set; the rule is re-applied inside every LOOCV fold and bootstrap resample, and the hold-out set is never used for a choice.
